name: Champ De Bataille
summary:
# “They called me to the 3rd North Trench. Gotta fix a phone line. Hurry up! It's blowing up everywhere. Miserable weather, Captain. Can't hear much anyway. Ears got blasted by a shell. This war’s a curse. I'm 20 and don't even have a gun.”


The Earth carries all of mankind’s memories within it. But when people suffer, their pain and
torment always rise to the surface. In 1916, the fields of Verdun were the theatre of
unprecedented barbarism. Battered bodies, mutilated landscapes, darkened skies of despair
